data.title: 春日野穹 · 夏日乡道的白裙
data.description: 奥木染町的乡间道路，她穿着白色连衣裙走在蝉鸣里，双手背在身后抱着兔子布偶；远处是稻田与积雨云，她微微眯眼躲避阳光，像一幅会呼吸的油画。
data.action: 奥木染町的乡间道路，她穿着白色连衣裙走在蝉鸣里，双手背在身后抱着兔子布偶
data.promptProse: Sora Kasugano walks along Okukozome's country road, both hands behind her holding a rabbit plush as she squints against the summer sun. Her opaque white knee-length dress, black hair ribbons and flat shoes remain simple. The medium view opens onto rice fields and towering clouds beyond the roadside. Sunlight brightens white hair and dress folds, with a clear walking shadow on the road and softer green reflections from the fields.
